researchQuestion: Does PIT financing-maturity structure add incremental information beyond PIT accounting leverage/liquidity controls (D07) and PIT rate context (D13) for later Taiwan-equity downside/risk outcomes?

universe.scope: Taiwan listed non-financial corporates with replayable issuer/date maturity disclosures
universe.survivorshipRule: Use issuer availability at knownAt; delisted/distressed issuers must not be silently dropped when source coverage is available.

exposureDefinition.bucket: <1y common-support only for first-stage cross-issuer test

liquidityBuffer.facilities: analyze separately; do not add 100% to cash unless commitment quality and drawability are verified

controls.name: net_interest_bearing_debt_intensity
controls.definition: (verified interest-bearing debt - cash and cash equivalents) / total assets, PIT

controls.name: operating_cash_flow_support
controls.definition: trailing operating cash flow / verified interest-bearing debt when denominator is positive, PIT

D07Baseline.readinessRule: If required PIT balance-sheet or cash-flow fields are unavailable at knownAt, the issuer/date is not scored as zero; the control is UNKNOWN and the applicable incremental test is blocked or restricted to complete-case preregistered analysis.

controls.name: ust_10y_level
controls.definition: latest known U.S. Treasury 10-year yield before Taiwan outcome start

controls.name: ust_10y_change_20td
controls.definition: 20-trading-day change using PIT market calendar alignment

controls.name: cbc_policy_rate
controls.definition: latest known CBC policy rate before Taiwan outcome start

D13Baseline.timingRule: No future macro release, revised vintage or post-Taiwan-close information may enter the baseline.

primary.name: forward_60td_max_drawdown
primary.definition: maximum close-to-close drawdown over next 60 Taiwan trading days from first eligible next session; sign convention frozen before data join

secondary.name: forward_60td_total_return
secondary.definition: close-to-close total price return over next 60 Taiwan trading days; descriptive secondary

secondary.name: forward_20td_total_return
secondary.definition: close-to-close total price return over next 20 Taiwan trading days; short-horizon secondary

outcomes.rule: Primary result remains 60-trading-day max drawdown even if a secondary horizon looks better.

falsificationGates: D22 improvement disappears after D07 and D13 controls
effect exists only in one issuer/industry/date cluster
result depends on synthetic bucket splitting
result flips after excluding stale/low-quality facilities
result is driven by look-ahead publication timing or revised disclosures
coverage loss or UNKNOWN handling creates apparent improvement
transaction-cost or tradability constraints erase any actionable value
promotionRule: L4 requires OOS or prospective evidence. No Formal optimization candidate unless incremental value survives applicable falsification, redundancy, coverage, regime, cost and overfit controls.
